_doc: Claude adjudication of the round-4 hunt labels, 2026-10-20, written BEFORE any case is run through any checker. Two blind sonnet judges per case (a LITERAL copy-editor lens and an ORDINARY-reader lens) labelled every case U/F/B from an anonymised, shuffled, label-free copy (workflow wf_a8450b08-493). 139 of 177 were unanimous with the skeptic. The rule, fixed before any run and applied mechanically: a U case becomes B if the skeptic flagged it arguable, or EITHER judge read it as supported (F), or BOTH judges read it as either-way (B); an F case becomes B if either judge read it as unsupported or both read it as either-way; every other case keeps the skeptic's label (so a U case with one judge U and one judge B stays U). B is counted in the strict reading only, as in round 3.
